name: Browser
description: A browser in a Kith tab. You use it with your hands; he drives the same page.

commands.name: open
commands.title: Open a page
commands.description: Go to an address in the Browser tab. Waits until the page has settled, and answers with its title and where it ended up after any redirects.

commands.name: read
commands.title: Read the page
commands.description: The visible text of the page, as a person would read it. A few hundred tokens for an ordinary page. Reach for this before looking at a picture.

commands.name: click
commands.title: Click something
commands.description: Click by what it says — click(text: "Sign in"). A CSS selector works too, for an icon with no label. If nothing matches, the answer lists what is clickable so you can pick without taking a screenshot.

text.description: The words on the thing to click.

selector.description: A CSS selector, when text will not do.

commands.name: type
commands.title: Type into the page
commands.description: Type into whatever is focused, or name a field with `into` to click it first. This is a paste rather than keystrokes, so it survives fields that reformat as you go.

into.description: The field's label or selector, if it needs focusing first.

commands.name: press
commands.title: Press a key
commands.description: A key that means something rather than a character — Enter to submit a form, Tab to move on, Escape to dismiss.

commands.name: scroll
commands.title: Scroll the page
commands.description: Scroll down by a number of pixels, or up with a negative one. Only needed for pages that load as you scroll — `read` already returns text below the fold.

commands.name: back
commands.title: Go back
commands.description: Back one page, the way the button does.

commands.name: look
commands.title: Look at the page
commands.description: A screenshot, written to a file. Costs almost nothing until you read it — and reading one costs a few thousand tokens, so only look when layout is the question or they asked what it looks like.
